title: 3DS Simulation Request object
description: Request object for simulating a 3DS authentication

merchant.description: Merchant information for the simulated transaction

country.description: Country of the address provided by the cardholder in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format (e.g. USA)

id.description: Unique identifier to identify the payment card acceptor. Corresponds to `merchant_acceptor_id` in authorization.

mcc.description: Merchant category code for the transaction to be simulated. A four-digit number listed in ISO 18245. Supported merchant category codes can be found [here](https://docs.lithic.com/docs/transactions#merchant-category-codes-mccs).

name.description: Merchant descriptor, corresponds to `descriptor` in authorization. If CHALLENGE keyword is included, Lithic will trigger a challenge.

card_expiry_check.description: When set will use the following values as part of the Simulated Authentication. When not set defaults to MATCH
